Material properties of diamond.question: Bort diamonds, found in _____, Venezuela, and Guyana, are the most common type of industrial-grade diamond
Material properties of diamond.fact: Some diamonds found in Brazil and the Democratic Republic of the Congo are polycrystalline and occur as opaque, darkly colored, spherical, radial masses of tiny crystals; these are called ballas and are important to industry as they lack the cleavage planes of single-crystal diamond. Bort diamonds, found in Brazil, Venezuela, and Guyana, are the most common type of industrial-grade diamond.

Material properties of diamond.subject: Indian Archaeology & Epigraphy
Material properties of diamond.question: If the N atoms are in pairs or larger aggregates, they do not affect the diamond's color; these are _____
Material properties of diamond.fact: If the N atoms are in pairs or larger aggregates, they do not affect the diamond's color; these are Type Ia. About 98% of gem diamonds are type Ia: these diamonds belong to the Cape series, named after the diamond-rich region formerly called Cape Province in South Africa, whose deposits are largely Type Ia.
